integrity: The proof is self-contained apart from elementary Gaussian/chi-square facts and a standard deterministic append-column inequality, which is rederived via orthonormal-factor bounds. Computations are diagnostics, not substitutes for the infinite-horizon limit.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite real dimensions, independent isotropic Gaussian perturbations, exact normalization, predictable perpendicular signals of deterministic finite lengths; no claim about actual machine rounding or complex/correlated perturbations. The general tail coefficient is a finite expectation, not a universal elementary constant.
title: Sharp condition-number tails for sequential Gaussian-perturbed QR columns
